snippet.title: Rotwood – Launch Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
snippet.description:
Rotwood is hacking-and-slashing its way exclusively onto Nintendo Switch 2. Play today: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/rotwood-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=A1013-01&utm_id=A1013-01

Rotwood is a stylish side-scrolling co-op action brawler from Klei Entertainment, the studio behind the Don’t Starve series.

Choose your weapon, master deep combat combos, and experiment with gear to create powerful builds. Progress comes from your growing skill as much as your loot, with challenging boss fights that demand precision and smart teamwork. Battle corrupted beasts through dangerous forest arenas, solo or with up to three friends locally or online.

#IndieWorld #Rotwood #NintendoSwitch2

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
